Title: Imibhalo engezansi yomdlalo
Subtitle: Humusha imibhalo engezansi yesiNgisi kusuka ku-PS5 yakho ku-OBS.
ConnectHint: Engeza umbhalo endaweni yakho yegeyimu kanye.
TestHint: Zama umugqa wesampula ngaphambi kokuxhuma ikhonsoli.
SelectHint: Dweba ibhokisi elizungeze imibhalo engezansi yesiNgisi kuhlaka lomdlalo.
AreaReady: Indawo yombhalo ongezansi ilondoloziwe. Vula ikhamera ebonakalayo ye-OBS.
Help: Khetha isigcawu sakho somdlalo ku-OBS. Vula Amathuluzi → Imibhalo bese uchofoza +. Namathisela indlela yombhalo bese uvule ifayela. Chofoza inkinobho kuzilungiselelo zombhalo ukuze wengeze imibhalo engezansi esigcawini. Buyela ku-SubZir futhi uhlole ukuhumusha.
Checking: Ifunda umugqa wesampula futhi ibheka uxhumo lwe-OBS...
TestSuccess: I-OBS ithole umugqa wesampula. Hlola ukuma kwayo endaweni yesigameko.
TestNoAck: Ukuhumusha kuphumelele, kodwa i-OBS ayizange ikuqinisekise. Khetha indawo yegeyimu yakho bese uphinda isinyathelo 1.
Waiting: Ilinde imibhalo engezansi yesiNgisi evela kukhamera ebonakalayo ye-OBS...
OcrMissing: Faka ukubonwa kombhalo wesiNgisi ku-Windows. Bheka umhlahlandlela ukuze uthole imiyalelo.
CheckCamera: Hlola ikhamera ebonakalayo bese ukhetha indawo yemibhalo engezansi futhi.
TestFailed: Ukuhlolwa akukwazanga ukuqeda. Vula Ukuxazulula inkinga kumhlahlandlela.
TestEmpty: Awukho umugqa wesampula owamukelwe. Zama ukuhlola futhi.
NoFrame: Alukho uhlaka olutholiwe. Ku-OBS, qala ikhamera ebonakalayo bese uphinda isinyathelo sesi-3.
Saved: Indawo ilondoloziwe. Chofoza okuthi Qala ukuhumusha.
LaunchError: Khipha yonke i-ZIP kokuthi Amadokhumenti bese uzama futhi.
Picker: Dweba ibhokisi elizungeze indawo lomugqa owodwa noma emibili yesihlokwana
GuideBody: Nika amandla imibhalo engezansi yesiNgisi kugeyimu yakho. Xhuma ikhadi lokuthwebula ku-OBS. Engeza umbhalo ongezansi esigcawini somdlalo. Setha okukhiphayo kwekhamera ebonakalayo emthonjeni wekhadi lokuthwebula bese uqala ikhamera ebonakalayo. Ku-SubZir, khetha indawo yemibhalo engezansi bese uqala ukuhumusha.
ModelError: Imodeli yokuhumusha ayikwazanga ukuqedela isicelo. Bona i-runtime/diagnostics.txt.
